spec_match.rationale: Shows raw getPathData() and getPathData({normalize:true}) for any d, and draws the normalized segments with setPathData() as an overlay to check geometry.

interactive.rationale: The preset select, a free d textarea (rAF-throttled) and live tables plus preview.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Raw vs normalized tables for all 20 commands, as promised.

edge_cases.rationale: Empty d gives []. The copy explains render-up-to-the-error for invalid commands. The invalid preset was removed because the browser logs a console error for a malformed d.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus and the SVGPathData spec.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 headless: by default all three methods are undefined (each page shows its labelled unsupported state). With --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, getPathData/setPathData are live but getPathSegmentAtLength is still undefined. Both viewports, every control exercised, console/network clean, 0px overflow. With the flag, the 'all 20 commands' preset normalized to M/L/C/Z only.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts that normalize returns only MLCZ on every render, plus the support state.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; the solid blue vs dashed rose legend is explained in text.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled select and textarea, an SVG title, a status summary and scrollable named table regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Fixed a 117px mobile overflow (select width) found by measurement. Tables collapse to one column below 760px.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Controls should be at least 44x44 CSS px on touch screens, and components should adapt to their container so nothing overflows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons, selects, inputs and ranges have min-height 44px. Selects inside .field are width:100% after a measured 117px overflow at 360px caused by long option text. Every page was re-measured at 0px overflow at 360x740 and 1280x800.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: drive.js runs: overflow=0 on every page/viewport; responsive-check desktop ok 1/1, mobile ok 1/1

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native controls with labels. Announce discrete outcomes through polite status/log regions and keep rapidly changing values out of live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every control is a native button/select/input with a visible label. Outcomes go to role=status / role=log regions. High-frequency readouts (slider positions, meters) use aria-live=off and announce only on change of state.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive grid of readouts collapsing to one column
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use grid with min-width:0 children and let tracks collapse on narrow containers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Fact/readout grids are one column below 640px and min-width:0 on grid children. A measured 91px overflow from <pre> blocks in a 2-column grid was fixed with .cmp > div { min-width: 0 }.

summary: The canonical read surface: native raw and normalized segments side by side, with no JS parser on the page.
